text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Noel Lindsay cut his earnings and revenue estimates on 3Com Corp's current quarter and the 1997 fiscal year but reiterated his buy rating on the stock, his office said.

-- Lindsay cut his earnings estimate for the fiscal third quarter ending later this month to $0.58 per share from $0.63 per share previously. He reduced his revenue estimate for the quarter to $850 million from $875 million, his office said.
-- For fiscal 1997, the analyst cut his earnings estimate to $2.34 per share from $2.41. He lowered his revenue figure for the year to $3.31 billion from $3.36 billion.
-- The lower numbers reflect a slowdown the company experienced in the month of December, which executives had discussed at a meeting with analysts in New York last week, the office said.

-- Further research confirmed a slowdown had hit during December in 3Com's two-tier distribution system, which relies on indirect distributors like Tech Data Corp and Merisel Inc to resell many of 3Com's products, Lindsay's associate said.
-- A shift had occured in the PC market toward direct marketers such as Dell Computer Corp and Gateway 2000 Inc, which had in turn created an inventory back-up among indirect suppliers.

-- As a result, distributors stopped buying for a few weeks in December to reduce their own inventories, but the analyst believes this to be an anomaly, and not part of a longer trend, Lindsay's office said.
